name: Two coins, no sell window
oneLine: Each monthly amount is split between Bitcoin and Ethereum; you can add a sell window.
explanation:
2 coins, Bitcoin and Ethereum, bought every month and held, with no date to sell unless you add one. Bitcoin fell 78 % from its high on 10 November 2021 to its low on 21 November 2022. Ethereum fell 82 % from its high on 10 November 2021 to its low on 18 June 2022.

People pick it when they want 2 coins rather than 3 or 4. What can go wrong: both falls began on the same day, so 2 coins are not 2 separate risks. A fall of that size can come again.
